correctness.rationale: The face rule is exactly induced degree <=1. Two independent exact membership predicates agree on all 4,16,256,65536 subsets for d=1,2,3,4. The matching rule is explicitly reproducible; every directed Hasse incidence was checked by exhaustive topological sort, with 3,10,76,3054 faces and 1,3,36,1518 matched pairs, leaving precisely (1), (1+3 in degree 1), (1+3 in degree 2), and (1+16 in degree 3+1 in degree 4) critical cells. The only potentially nonzero integral Morse differential, 16 by 1, is identically zero by exact signed recursive gradient-path calculation. The Hurewicz isomorphism in degree 3 for the wedge of sixteen 3-spheres then makes the unique 4-cell attach trivially. Independent GF(2) simplicial ranks corroborate homology. Standalone code and recorded output accompany the result.

value.rationale: The hypercube sequence is canonical; the first four degrees form a complete natural finite cutoff, showing the first mixed-dimensional two-independence homotopy at the tesseract. The two-degree integral wedge is a structural non-equidimensional boundary, not a recomputation of ordinary independence or a random parameter choice. Exact homotopy and the relative location of low-degree homology beneath maximal 7-faces can serve as a concrete benchmark for cubical higher-independence methods without requiring an all-dimensional theorem.
